sn21.1:1.3: Kolita was his personal name, Moggallāna his clan name.
sn21.1:2.7: So-called because of the absence of _vitakka_ and _vicāra_, which are the precursors of speech ([sn41.6:2.4](), [mn44:15.3]()).
sn21.1:2.8: The verb _viharati_ here and below, and in the parallel passages at [sn40.1]()ff., uses the aorist and present tenses inconsistently. I take the first passage as historical present, the second as aorist in simple past tense.
sn21.1:2.9: In the Suttas, _saññāmanasikārā_ is only used in negative contexts, but later texts use it in a positive way as well ([ps1.1:171.5](),  [pe8:3.3]()).
sn21.1:3.5: A series of similar conversations on different states of meditation is found in the Moggallānasaṁyutta (SN 40).
